title: Nashville Hot Tub & Game Room House, Sleeps 13
description:
Howdy BACH is your Airbnb bachelorette headquarters near downtown Nashville, complete with a game room stage and a private hot tub for after dark.
• Sleeps 13 across 4 bedrooms and 9 beds
• 4 full bathrooms
• Private hot tub
• Game room with karaoke stage, beer pong, and cornhole
• Custom mural and photo wall
• Garage plus free street parking

The space
You walk in to bride balloons, cowhide chairs, and neon signs, and you know instantly this trip is not a quiet one. Howdy BACH is built to gather a group and keep the party going long after the bars close. Four bedrooms spread across three floors mean everyone gets their own corner, from a stacked-bed room for the crew to a private master for whoever booked the trip.

With 9 beds and 4 full bathrooms, nobody's fighting over the shower schedule in the morning. The game room is set inside an open garage bay, stage lights, pink guitars, cornhole, and a mural wall built for group photos. Grab the mic for karaoke, run a beer pong tournament, then soak in the private hot tub once the night winds down.

A day exploring downtown Nashville, dinner off the grill back at the house, karaoke and beer pong once the sun sets, then a late soak in the hot tub before everyone crashes: that's the shape of a weekend here.

AMENITIES FOR THE PERFECT STAY
Outdoor
• Private hot tub
• Gas grill
• Garage plus free street parking
Entertainment
• Game room with karaoke stage, mics, and beer pong
• Cornhole set
• Custom mural and photo wall
Home
• Fully equipped kitchen with island and bar seating
• Living room with sofa and armchair seating
• Smart TVs
Convenience
• Keyless smart lock entry
• Washer/dryer

BEDROOM LAYOUT
Bedrooms are spread across three floors so friend groups and families can each claim their own space and still gather together at night.
• 1st floor bedroom: 3 twin beds
• 2nd floor bedroom: Queen bed plus a twin trundle bed
• 3rd floor master bedroom: King bed
• 3rd floor bedroom: 2 full beds plus a twin trundle bed

This layout is built for bachelorette parties, birthday weekends, and friend groups who want their own space but come together at night. It's not designed for events with unregistered guests. Houses this close to downtown with a hot tub and karaoke setup book out fast for Nashville weekends, especially through fall festival season, so reserve your dates while they're open

Guest access
Self check-in is quick and easy with a smart lock, so your group can head straight for the hot tub after a long drive.

This property has special local compliance requirements which include a signed rental agreement, ID verification, and a security hold of $1,500 (which is not a traditional security deposit, just a pending transaction). As an optional alternative to the security hold, you may opt in to purchase a non-refundable damage waiver provided by a third-party insurance company. The optional damage waiver is $89 for stays up to 10 nights, with an additional $2 per day for stays longer than 10 nights. Damage waiver purchases are optional.

To make this process easy for you, we use a secure and very simple, app-free platform called Happy Guest. It is not an app, and you do not have to sign up for an account - it’s a safe and secure website. It also gives you a guest portal with all the info about the home, all of my favorite local spots, and discounted upgrades to your stay.
